bull_case: Management converts the AI demand shock into durable margin, capacity and service leadership while disciplined acquisitions fill power/cooling gaps at attractive returns.
bear_case: The organization overbuilds capacity and pays peak-cycle prices for acquisitions, converting an excellent operating cycle into lower future returns.
thesis: Execution has been strong: margins, cash flow and backlog conversion improved while internal controls were effective. Management has also used acquisitions to extend liquid cooling and power architecture. The main capital-allocation question is whether the $1.45B upfront plus contingent UIG consideration earns acceptable returns near a cyclical demand peak, so capital allocation is scored below governance and execution.

evidence.claim: Management reported internal control over financial reporting effective as of Dec. 31, 2025.
Operating profit increased from $872M in 2023 to $1.830B in 2025 and Q2 2026 operating profit rose 44.2% YoY.
PurgeRite added liquid-cooling services and the signed UIG transaction adds microgrid controls, switchgear and behind-the-meter power architecture.
UIG consideration is about $1.45B upfront cash plus up to $1.15B contingent cash, making post-close returns a material test of allocation discipline.

counterevidence: Acquisition economics for UIG are not yet observable because the deal had not closed by the cutoff.
Demand strength can make management execution look better during a favorable cycle.
The fetched DEFA14A is not a complete definitive proxy, limiting detailed compensation analysis.
Capacity expansion and inventory growth raise the cost of a forecasting error.
unknowns: UIG purchase multiple and synergy realization.
Executive compensation details from definitive proxy.
Any explicit hurdle rates for acquisitions and capacity projects.
falsifiers: A material impairment or weak post-close UIG cash return would cut capital-allocation score.
Sustained margin/FCF gains through a demand slowdown would strengthen execution score.
A control weakness or accounting restatement would reopen V1.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: FY2025 internal controls were effective and no fraud, material restatement or integrity breach is identified in the cutoff materials.

subscores.rationale: R&D, capacity and prior portfolio expansion have produced strong growth, but the large peak-cycle UIG commitment is not yet seasoned enough for an 80-90 score.
Effective internal controls and no identified accounting-integrity issue support high trust, subject to incomplete proxy compensation detail.
Management scaled capacity, margins, cash flow and portfolio breadth rapidly in response to the AI data-center architecture shift.

uncertainties.rationale: The largest current acquisition had not closed, so realized returns are unknown.
Full proxy compensation data are not in the frozen Stage 0 pack.
Execution has not yet been tested through a sharp AI capex downturn.
